facts.text: WorkSafe New Zealand, WorkSafe Western Australia and Britain's Health and Safety Executive (HSE) are workplace-safety regulators whose incident reports or statistics the booklet uses; EU-OSHA is a European information agency used mainly for legislation summaries.
facts.quote: These are workplace-safety regulators and agencies whose incident reports and statistics the booklet uses

entities.name: European Agency for Safety and Health at Work

facts.text: WorkSafe New Zealand is the national regulator, and its extractives inspectorate covers mines and quarries.
facts.quote: WorkSafe New Zealand is the national regulator; its extractives inspectorate covers mines and quarries.

facts.text: WorkSafe New Zealand's August 2017 alert was triggered by “numerous” interactions involving heavy mobile plant.
facts.quote: Its August 2017 alert was triggered by "numerous" interactions involving heavy mobile plant

facts.text: WorkSafe New Zealand's August 2017 alert described a dozer reversing into a loaded dump truck at a tip head.
facts.quote: a dozer reversing into a loaded dump truck at a tip head

facts.text: WorkSafe New Zealand's August 2017 alert described a night-shift truck clipping a dozer.
facts.quote: a night-shift truck clipping a dozer

facts.text: WorkSafe New Zealand's August 2017 alert described a loader bucket tipping a loader onto its side during stockpile loading.
facts.quote: a loader bucket tipping a loader onto its side during stockpile loading

facts.text: WorkSafe New Zealand's quarterly data for late 2019 classified vehicle events as 46 percent overturning, 27 percent unintended movement or brake failure, and 11 percent collision with other plant.
facts.quote: Its quarterly data for late 2019 split vehicle events as 46 percent overturning, 27 percent unintended movement or brake failure and 11 percent collision with other plant

facts.text: WorkSafe New Zealand explicitly warned that reporting underlying its late-2019 quarterly vehicle-event data was incomplete.
facts.quote: with an explicit warning that reporting was incomplete

facts.text: WorkSafe Western Australia is distinct from WorkSafe New Zealand and is the source of the Significant Incident Reports cited by the booklet.
facts.quote: WorkSafe Western Australia is a different regulator with a similar name, and it is the source of the Significant Incident Reports (SIR) the booklet cites.

facts.text: WorkSafe Western Australia's SIR 286 records operators approaching autonomous haul trucks during recovery without recognizing that the trucks were in exception mode rather than suspended; the trucks resumed moving when communications were restored.
facts.quote: SIR 286 records operators who approached autonomous haul trucks during a recovery without recognizing that the trucks were in exception mode rather than suspended; when communications were restored the trucks resumed moving.

facts.text: Contributory factors in SIR 286 were lack of understanding of system modes, limited communications redundancy, the ability to override safety controls, failure to observe status lights, and desensitization after prior communication problems.
facts.quote: Contributory factors were lack of understanding of system modes, limited communications redundancy, the ability to override safety controls, failure to observe status lights and desensitization after prior communication problems

facts.text: WorkSafe Western Australia's SIR 226 describes an autonomous truck colliding with a manned water cart at night after a route was released in the control system but not marked on the ground.
facts.quote: SIR 226 describes an autonomous truck colliding with a manned water cart at night after a route was released in the control system but not marked on the ground

facts.text: The Health and Safety Executive (HSE) is Great Britain's regulator, and the booklet uses HSE national figures.
facts.quote: The Health and Safety Executive (HSE) is Great Britain's regulator; its figures appear under the United Kingdom entry

facts.text: EU-OSHA, the European Agency for Safety and Health at Work, is an information agency rather than a regulator; the booklet cites EU-OSHA's summary of the Machinery Regulation.
facts.quote: EU-OSHA, the European Agency for Safety and Health at Work, is an information agency rather than a regulator; the booklet cites its summary of the Machinery Regulation

entities.name: European Agency for Safety and Health at Work

facts.text: The booklet did not find EU-OSHA breakdowns of machine collisions by movement type.
facts.quote: EU-OSHA breakdowns of machine collisions by movement type were not found

entities.name: European Agency for Safety and Health at Work

facts.text: The booklet interprets SIR 286 as a direct warning that degraded and recovery modes can be more dangerous than normal operation.
facts.quote: SIR 286 is the booklet's direct warning that degraded and recovery modes can be more dangerous than normal operation

facts.text: The booklet interprets SIR 286 as a warning that repeated faults desensitize people.
facts.quote: and that repeated faults desensitize people

facts.text: Based on SIR 286, the booklet says test plans must include communications loss, blocked sensors, restart and recovery cases.
facts.quote: so test plans must include communications loss, blocked sensors, restart and recovery cases

facts.text: The booklet concludes that the New Zealand incidents show ordinary production tasks at tip heads and stockpiles produce collisions.
facts.quote: The New Zealand events show that ordinary production tasks at tip heads and stockpiles produce the collisions
